# Helvety Docs

> Edit .docx files in the browser. Local editing needs no account. The editor opens to a blank document; use **New** anytime for a fresh page. Optional vault save encrypts document titles and file bytes on your device before storage.

## Canonical URL
- [Helvety Docs](https://helvety.com/docs): Browser-based Word (.docx) editor
- Vault bookmarks may use `?doc=<uuid>` in shared or sign-in return URLs; the editor always starts blank on load (the query is not auto-opened). Open saved documents from the vault sidebar when signed in and vault-unlocked; the URL may show `?doc=<uuid>` after you open or save from the app

## User Interface
- Light and dark mode via the navbar theme switcher (system, light, or dark)
- Pinned command bar (New, Open, Download, Save to vault), vault sidebar, and dialogs use the shared Helvety design system (square corners, warm neutrals, red accent)
- Eigenpal editor chrome (formatting toolbar, Format/Insert menus, workspace gutter) follows the selected theme via a CSS bridge; the vendor default title-bar doc icon and Help menu are hidden (file actions live in the command bar)
- The printable document page stays white with dark text in both themes so exported .docx files remain print-accurate

## Crawling And Indexing
- The main editor route at `/docs` is intended to be indexable.
- `robots.txt` disallows site-root `/api` and `/auth` paths. Vault API routes under `/docs/api` require authentication and are not public crawl targets.
